sloka: स पुत्रवधसन्तप्तः शूरः क्रोधवशं गतः।समीक्ष्य रावणो बुद्ध्या वैदेह्या रोचयद्वधम् ।। ६.९३.२० ।।
transliteration: sa putravadhasantaptaḥ śūraḥ krodhavaśaṁ gataḥ।samīkṣya rāvaṇo buddhyā vaidehyā rocayadvadham ।। 6.93.20 ।।

translations.english: Pondering over the death of his asura son, Ravana was overtaken by fury, and reviwed thinking about the destruction of Vaidehi.
